answer: I never drink coffee in the evening.
other_correct: Never do I drink coffee in the evening.
instruction_problem: Fine, but 'the right place' is vague about whether to rewrite the whole sentence; a learner may type only a fragment. Inverted 'Never do I drink...' is also correct (formal/emphatic, much less natural, not expected at B1).
level_problem: Position of never/frequency adverbs is A2 material; slightly easy for B1.1 (sentence itself is fine).
